node.title: Re^3: Replace value in the text file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
[mod://Text::CSV_XS], its slower pure-perl implementation [mod://Text::CSV]

From the doc of the latter:

Text::CSV is a thin wrapper for [mod://Text::CSV_XS]-compatible modules now. ... Text::CSV uses Text::CSV_XS by default, and when Text::CSV_XS is not available, falls back on [mod://Text::CSV_PP], which is bundled in the same distribution as this module.

Personally, I usually recommend [mod://Text::CSV], although I guess I should start telling people to make sure [mod://Text::CSV_XS] is installed as well :-)
